entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2208a
entries.finding: Stephan's Quintet (NIRCam + MIRI Imaging): Webb NIRCam and MIRI, from 0.9 to 7.7 µm: near-infrared blue to orange, mid-infrared yellow and red; 4000 × 3835 px over 6.34 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.09505 arcsec per pixel, north 62.0° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 338.99763°, 33.9604911°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
